product_one_liner.value: Incorta gives enterprise business and data teams a governed platform for analyzing live, detailed operational data and building AI applications and agents without complex ETL pipelines.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page or pricing link was found on the company site; /pricing did not return a page. Public prices do appear separately on AWS Marketplace, rather than an Incorta website pricing page.

founded_year.notes: Current company materials state 2013; the older 2021 funding announcement instead stated 2014.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts sit within the main blog, not a separately branded engineering blog. Principal ML Engineer Ebrahim Alareqi explains agent security implementation and the live-data/Direct Data Mapping architecture in posts dated March 6 and October 2, 2026; his July 22 post identifies his engineering role.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current board lists Solution Engineer, Principle Software Engineer and Senior Software Engineer; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title. AI infrastructure work in a software-engineer description is not counted.

model_provider.value: OpenAI; Azure OpenAI; Meta Llama 3.1; Anthropic Claude; Google Gemini
model_provider.notes: These are publicly named supported/configurable models and providers, not a claim that every deployment uses all of them.

compliance_certs.notes: The product page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II certification. Broader standards-adherence language is not treated as proof of additional certifications.

last_funding.notes: Latest company-announced equity round found: June 23, 2021. PitchBook displays April 24, 2025 for a $120M Series D, conflicting with the primary announcement; that later date was not independently corroborated.

raised_18mo.notes: No later financing announcement was found in the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window; the latest company-disclosed equity round predates it. The conflicting April 2025 database date also falls outside the window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Direct employer postings for Sales Development Representative - USA and Account Executive remain readable with application links, although they are not surfaced in the board landing-page text.

launched_6mo.notes: June 30, 2026: Incorta Intelligence became generally available, including Incorta Builder, Smart Agent and governed workflow automation; this falls within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Omar Hajsaleh announced joining as VP of Sales for EMEA on December 1, 2025; his profile also gives December 2025 as the start date, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting explicitly requires managing prospect interactions in Salesforce and Outreach; Gong and Apollo appear as examples of relevant sales-tool experience, a weaker adoption signal.
